translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Matyiw
book.title: MATYIW Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Matyiw Tikak

content: Biynimb Gok Kuyip Tap Monmon Ñinimimb
“Pen nimb biynimb windin yirik ar ak nep mindrep ginjun aŋgiy, gem amniŋgamb ak; Gor nimbip yergiy direp giniŋgamb.

Biynimb Gor nup gosimb niŋbun aŋgiy tom nep gipay gok, gipay rek ma ginimimb. Kiyk biynimb simbgeprek gok kuyip maniy ñiniŋg nan-gep korip biynimb kuŋay mindpay namb ak akaŋ, kinjeŋ yomb okok nep ñimbay. Yimb yomb dun aŋgiy gipay kun ak, Gor kuyip direp ginimuŋ rek ma ayip.
“Pen nimb biynimb simbgeprek gok kuyip tap ñiniŋg, miseŋ ma ñinimimb;
kapkap weygiy ñinimimb. Tap weygiy gipun gok Bapiy Gor niŋimb ak mey, giniŋgambim kun ak niŋiy, nimbip direp giniŋgamb.
Gor Nup Kun Giy Aŋgniŋep

“Nimb Gor nup aŋgniŋniŋg, biynimb yesek gunap gipay rek ma ginimimb. Kiyk biynimb gunap chinup niŋey yimb yomb diniŋgambun aŋgiy, am lotiw korip namb ak mindiy akaŋ, am kinjeŋram okok mindiy, Gor nup aŋgniŋbay. Yimb yomb diniŋg gipay kun ak, Gor minim kuyip ak ma niŋniŋgamb.
Kun ak nimb Gor nup aŋgniŋniŋg; korip ñiluk miŋgan ak amiy, kinjeŋ giñiy, Bapiy nup aŋgniŋnimimb. Tap kapkap gipim ak maŋgiysek niŋimb rek, minim kun ak niŋiy, aŋgniŋniŋgambim rek giniŋgamb.
“Biynimb Gor minim ma niŋbay gok, nup aŋgniŋniŋg, minim paryomb yimb apay. Gos kiyk ak minim paryomb aŋgon mey niŋniŋgamb apay!
Pen nimb kun ak rek ma ginimimb. Minim yerip Gor nup aŋgniŋniŋg gipim gok, nuk nind niŋimb.
Nup aŋgniŋniŋg, kun giy aŋgnimimb:

content.text: ‘Bapiy yomb semb biyoŋ; yimb nand yiy ar biyoŋ mindip.
Nand chinup diy kond mindenimin; semb biyoŋ aŋgek niŋbay rek ak, chinup gey kun ak rek niŋjun.
Chinup tap ñiŋemb minek minek ñimbun rek ak ñinimin.
Biynimb gunap chinup timey gey niŋiy kirpun rek, tap siy tap timey chin gipun gok niŋiy kirginimin.
Chin yikop mindiy, tap siy tap timey giniŋgambun rek ayip ak; chinup kond mindey, timey ma ginjun.’

content: “Pen biynimb gunap nimbip timey gey, niŋiy kirgeniŋgambim; Gor tap siy tap timey nimb giniŋgambim gok niŋiy kirginiŋgamb.
Pen nimb niŋiy ma kirginiŋgambim ak, Gor pen tap siy tap timey nimb giniŋgambim gok niŋiy ma kirginiŋgamb.
Tap Bul Gipay

“Nimb tap ñiŋemb kirginiŋg, biynimb yesek gok per gipay rek, ma ginimimb. Kiyk apay, miluk mer mer mindon, biynimb niŋiy aŋgniŋgambay, Gor nup gosimb niŋiy, tap ñiŋemb kirgiy mey, miluk mer mer mindpay aŋgniŋgambay. Nimbip niŋind yimb aspiyn: biynimb chinup niŋyaŋ aŋgiy giniŋgambay kun gok, yimb kuyip dand araniŋgambay ak pen, Gor kuyip direp ma giniŋgamb.
Nimb pen tap ñiŋemb gok kirginiŋg ginimimb ak; miluk mer mer ma mindenimimb. Ñiŋg pik tep giy, wel ay, kom giy mindenimimb.
Kun geniŋgambim, biynimb gunap nimbip tap keñmaŋgiy bul gipay aŋgiy, ma niŋniŋgambay; Gor nep tap weygiy gipun gok maŋgiysek niŋimb rek, nimbip niŋiy direp giniŋgamb.
Am Gor Yip Mindenjun Aŋgiy Niŋyiŋg Mindenimimb
“Pen man ar biy tap tep tep gok di nan-ginjun aŋgiy gos ak ma niŋnimimb. Tap kun gok nan-geniŋgambim; bi siydep apiy siy diniŋgambay akaŋ; simbsis giy, siplep siwiy giniŋgamb.
Kun ak tap tep nimb rek gok semb biyoŋ nan-gem; simbsis ma ginimuŋ, siplep ma siwnimuŋ, siy ma diniŋgiy, mindnep mindonimuŋ.
Tap tep nimb gok man ar biy di nan-geniŋgambim, gos nimb ak mindeniŋgamb man ar biy; semb ar biyoŋ nan-geniŋgambim; gos nimb ak amniŋgamb kun biyoŋ.
“Windin maŋgiy chin ak mey, lam rek mindip. Windin maŋgiy ak tep mindek; melik tep gamb niŋrep gipun.
Pen timey gek; kisyim apek ma niŋbun. Biynimb melik ma niŋbay gok, kisyimnamb okok mindpay.
Gor Yip, Maniy Tap Gok Yip

“Bi nokom bap, biyomb omiŋal woŋg giñinimuŋ rek ma ayip. Yenen: biyomb bap nup niŋek tep geniŋgamb, bap nup kirginiŋgamb: akaŋ bap nup niŋek tep geniŋgamb, bap nup kirginiŋgamb. Kun ak rek, nimb maniy tap tep lum ar biy mindip gok niŋem tep gek, Gor nup kirginiŋgambim rek ayip ak; niŋrep ginimimb.
Gos Yomb Ma Niŋnimimb
“Ar kun ak mey nimbip aspiyn: tap yerip ñimbiy mindenjun; chech akay nimb ay mindenjun aŋgiy, gos yomb ak ma niŋnimimb. Gor nimbip gayek mindpim ak; tap sikoy kun gok ma ñiniŋgamb?
Nimb niŋbim: yakir gok tap yiŋ ma yimbay; wiyt, rays, tap gok ma tik dap nan-gipay. Bapiy semb biyoŋ ak kuyip kond mindek tap ñimbay. Yakir tap yikop ak tap ñek ñimbay; nimbip kunep giniŋgamb.
Akaŋ, gosimb kuŋay niŋiy mey, tapin mindiy kumniŋgambun aŋgiy niŋbim?
“Pen yenen chech tap gok gos kuŋay niŋbim? Tap key jakip gok, chech napnap tap gok giniŋgiy rek ma ayip ak pen, sumsum teprep yimb gok mindip.
Kiyŋ Solomon tap kuŋay mindek ak pen; mokyaŋ tep kun gok rek ma gak.
Tap kaskas ak tap yikop. Per mindiy mer; miñiy rek mindiy, toy rek daŋgiypay. Pen Gor tap yikop kun gok gay mokyaŋ giñimb ak, yenen chinup ma kond mindeniŋgamb aŋgiy niŋbim?
“Kun ak ñiŋg akay ñiŋjun; tap yerip ñiŋjun; chech akay nimb ayjun aŋgiy, gos yomb ak ma niŋnimimb.
Biynimb Gor minim ma niŋbay gok, tap kun gok dun aŋgiy gos yomb kun ak rek niŋbay. Pen nimb niŋbim: Bapiy chin semb biyoŋ mindip ak tap nimb yerip tikdip ak niŋimb.
Kun ak, Gor biynimb gunap diy kond mindeniŋgamb ak, chinup sek dek biynimb suŋ-tep nuk gok mindonjun aŋgiy, nup gos nokom niŋiy gem amek mey; tap yikop kun gok diniŋgambim.
Kun ak toy yergiy mindenjun aŋgiy gos yomb ak ma niŋnimimb; Gor nimbip minek minek nep kond mindip.
